This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer aboard the ''[[Concussor]]'', an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Burst Fire-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel|''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> during one of the ''Concussor''{{'s}} patrols, the vessel picked up an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] containing [[Bhindi Drayson]] and her [[Wraith Squadron]] unit, a recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit that planned to take over the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="MK" />

When the Wraiths began their operation, [[Jesmin Tainer]] and [[Trey Courser]] were tasked with making their way to the auxiliary bridge and capturing it. On their way, they encountered the officer and a [[Unidentified Concussor officer (Trey Courser victim)|companion]] at an intersection. Tainer struck the officer in the solar plexus before following up with a palm strike to his temple, knocking him unconscious. Meanwhile, Courser subdued the officer's companion with a punch to the jaw. Courser then carried the two unconscious officers into a laundry supplies storage compartment to hide them.<ref name="MK" />

After the Wraiths succeeded in capturing the ''Concussor'', the entire crew was dropped off on a habitable [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of a distant [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with substantial provisions to live off.<ref name="MK" />
